description:
Activate Gilded Lotus by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Filigree Sages by paying {2}{U} targeting Gilded Lotus.
Rings of Brighthearth triggers, causing you to pay {2} to copying Filigree Sages' ability targeting Gilded Lotus.
Resolve the first Filigree Sages ability, untapping Gilded Lotus.
Activate Gilded Lotus by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Resolve the second Filigree Sages ability, untapping Gilded Lotus.
Repeat.
